summary.headline: Axiscades Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 20% YoY to ₹359.1 cr, but reported PAT of ₹47.3 cr rests on a ₹129.3 cr divestment gain.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was ₹359.1 cr, up 20% YoY and 3.6% QoQ, with retained (continuing) revenue of ₹195.6 cr up 30% YoY. Phase 1 of the Akkodis divestment closed on 30 September 2026, and continuing operations posted a ₹48.1 cr loss after a ₹38.4 cr non-cash goodwill and intangibles impairment (mainly ADD Solutions). Management said EBITDA was depressed by ESOP charges, corporate costs, legal and transaction costs and the ADD Solutions loss, and guided Q3 and Q4 margins recovering to roughly 15% and about 20% post-ESOP. Phase 2 closure has slipped from November to February or earlier.

financial_highlights.metric: Discontinued operations revenue Q2 FY27 (Ind AS 105)

financial_highlights.change: vs loss of ₹14.8 cr in Q1 FY27 and profit of ₹23.1 cr in Q2 FY26

financial_highlights.metric: Exceptional write-offs total (incl. ₹19.9 cr Epcogen goodwill in discontinued ops)

financial_highlights.change: Pre-ESOP EBITDA ₹23.4 cr; includes ₹12 cr H1 ESOP and ₹3.9 cr receivable provisions/ECL
Gross borrowing ₹624 cr; ~₹200 cr raised for Cloud Wave; ₹85 cr repaid in October

segments.name: Defence
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue ₹252.7 cr, up 46%; Q2 EBITDA ₹52.5 cr at 17.6% margin. Management said defence EBITDA pre-ESOP was ₹29 cr (23% margin) with XiDA combined.

segments.name: XiDA
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue ₹97.9 cr, up 55%, at 27.6% EBITDA margin; Q2 revenue up 47% YoY on new customer wins. Management expects triple-digit growth in Q3 and planned ₹81 cr revenue in Q3 and ₹90-105 cr in Q4.

segments.name: Aerospace
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue ₹23.1 cr. Cloud Wave (acquired 10 Sept 2026) contributed ₹16.5 cr in Q2 and was earnings accretive from its first quarter; full revenue expected in Q3 and Q4.

segments.name: Discontinued: Akkodis engineering services
segments.commentary: Reported as discontinued operations with ₹163.5 cr Q2 revenue. Management attributed Q2 margin decline (from about 18% to low-teens, per analyst) to appraisals, July increments, an Airbus plant shutdown and ₹3.7 cr ECL charge.

guidance_outlook: Q3 FY27: core (defence, XiDA, aerospace, space) revenue growth of at least 30% QoQ, band 45-50%; post-ESOP EBITDA margin about 15% (stated as an aim, not guidance).
Q4 FY27: about 30% QoQ growth over Q3; post-ESOP EBITDA margin at least 20% (plus or minus about 1.5%); ESOP charge to fall to single-digit percentage of EBITDA.
H2 FY27 executable order book execution of ₹600-720 cr, against ₹379 cr executed so far; management said it is not a formal guidance. Q3 revenue band ₹285-300 cr and Q4 ₹375-405 cr.

Full-year FY27 revenue: earlier ₹1,350 cr aspiration (May 2025, pre-divestment) now effectively re-based; management targets about ₹1,000 cr-plus in Part A plus ₹60-150 cr from acquisitions. Analyst cites ₹1,150 cr target.
Phase 2 Akkodis closure (aerospace engineering services, US$206 mn) targeted on or before February 2027; expected Q4 FY27 one-time gain of about ₹1,100 cr. Management said 100% confident.

Corporate overhead cut to about ₹12 cr per quarter; ESOP about ₹6 cr per quarter; legal and professional costs to normalise to ₹4-5 cr per quarter; XiDA, defence and aerospace each planned at around 20% EBITDA margin from Q3 FY27.
capex_capacity: Land acquired in Telangana for the Missile Assembly Complex (MAC), about 8+ acres registered in company's name; full functionality expected in 1-1.5 years plus about 6 months for certification; interim operations from Bangalore facility.
Devanahalli Aeroland move: about 500 employees relocated; transport cost per employee reduced from ₹27,000 to ₹22,000 per month, per management.
Employee cost guided at about ₹48 cr for Q3 and ₹54 cr for Q4 (band), with no increase planned.
Acquisition pipeline: about 4 companies lined up; management aims to close 2-3 in Q4 FY27, subject to ITAR and CFIUS approvals which could slip one or two quarters.
demand_pricing: Defence assured forecast visibility now close to ₹5,000 cr (up from about ₹4,500 cr); Q2 design wins above ₹80 cr added to the ₹730 cr assured forecast.
Based on current order book: DRDO ₹120 cr in Q3 and ₹150 cr in Q4; MoD direct ₹45 cr in Q3 and ₹60 cr in Q4.
XiDA received an order from US-based Humanoid Inc in the last month; ITSJ (acquired by XiDA) brought Google as a data-centre chiller customer and Applied Materials as a semicon equipment customer.
Supply-chain constraints in XiDA and defence: components and PCBs with lead times of 12-18 months; management expects to pay premiums, with a plus or minus 2% margin impact.

qa_highlights.question: Is the next-quarter margin guidance pre- or post-ESOP, and what are Q3 and Q4 margin expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said post-ESOP: about 15% EBITDA margin in Q3 and at least 20% in Q4, with 30-50% core revenue growth QoQ.

qa_highlights.question: Will the balance Akkodis consideration (about ₹1,000-1,100 cr gain) come in Q4 and what transaction costs apply?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO confirmed the gain is expected in Q4 FY27 on closing of Phase 2; about ₹35 cr of costs incurred so far with about ₹20 cr more expected.

qa_highlights.question: Why did divested business margins fall from about 18% to lower-teens, and is there a risk to the earn-out or guaranteed payments?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed the drop to July appraisals and increments, an Airbus plant shutdown, billable resources taken on with Akkodis consent and a ₹3.7 cr ECL charge. Guaranteed consideration is 74% of the total; earn-out (about ₹550 cr) depends on FY28 EBITDA, pro-rated (target about $18 mn; full payout not all-or-nothing).

qa_highlights.question: What is the executable order book and H2 execution plan, and does H2 revenue include future acquisitions?
qa_highlights.answer: About ₹1,000 cr total executable orders; ₹379 cr executed so far and ₹600-720 cr expected in H2. Chairman confirmed H2 is from existing businesses plus prorated Cloud Wave and ITSJ; acquisitions add ₹600-750 cr if closed.

qa_highlights.question: Is the defence assured forecast visibility being reduced?
qa_highlights.answer: Defence president said assured forecast is still held and is now close to ₹5,000 cr; forecast spans 3-4 years, not FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company seek a foreign partner or dilute its stake, and what is the status of the MAC?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is in joint-venture discussions with OEMs at subsidiary level, subject to government approvals. MAC land acquired; construction timing to be announced at the appropriate stage.

risks_watch: Phase 2 Akkodis closure slipped from November 2026 to February 2027 owing to new-company formation and MoD clearances; ₹1,100 cr Q4 gain and ₹504 cr February receipt depend on it.
Supply-chain delays (components with 12-18 month lead times) could slip XiDA and defence deliveries; management flagged ±2% margin risk from premium payments.
ESOP charge (₹12 cr in H1, about ₹6 cr per quarter guided) and legal and transaction costs continue to weigh on EBITDA; management says they will not recur.
Net debt ₹556 cr at 30 Sep 2026, with ~₹1,274 cr of guaranteed consideration pending to reduce debt; PAT and interest outlook not quantified by management.
CFO transition: Group CFO Shashidhar SK retires in December 2026; Uttam Bhageria takes over.
Acquisition timing dependent on ITAR and CFIUS approvals and could slip one to two quarters; management hinted at a possible XiDA fundraise under NDA.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the strategic pivot and Q4 benchmarks, but evasive on specifics: management repeatedly declined to call its margin and revenue numbers guidance, and answers on PAT, the FY27 revenue target and the forecast-visibility language were hedged.
key_quotes: The charges involved are one-time and non-cash. They do not touch our customers, our orders, or our cash, and they will not recur. I would rather show you a clean picture today than a comfortable one.
We anticipate the third quarter to be our first normal and profitable quarter. The fourth quarter will serve as the benchmark quarter for AXISCADES. We said what we would do, and we are doing it.
Post ESOP. I don't want to use the word guidance, but it's post-ESOP, what I'm giving you.. telling you. Post ESOP is our aim, basically.
And, regarding the PAT, it's a below-the-line EBITDA items, treasury cost and transactional cost, treasury costs and financial costs.
We are 100% confident about it, because the buyer is far, far more eager in terms of making this happen

adds.what: Missile Assembly Complex (MAC) in Telangana, land ~8+ acres acquired; interim operations from Bangalore facility
Devanahalli Aeroland move: ~500 employees relocated (relocation, not new capacity)

growth.why: Management guides Q3 revenue ₹285-300 cr and H2 execution of ₹600-720 cr, backed by a ₹379 cr executed so far, named DRDO/MoD orders (₹120+45 cr in Q3), XiDA order growth and Cloud Wave; but no new productive capacity commissioned in the period beyond the MAC land (live in 1-1.5 yrs plus ~6 months certification), and the ₹1,100 cr Phase 2 gain and FY27 re-based target are not capacity-backed.

oneOffs.what: Cloud Wave (acquired 10 Sept 2026) contributed ₹16.5 cr of Q2 revenue, consolidated only for the last few weeks of the quarter
Reported Q2 PAT of ₹47.3 cr rests on a ₹129.3 cr divestment gain (Akkodis Phase 1 closed 30 Sep 2026); this is a one-time gain outside the recurring business
₹38.4 cr non-cash goodwill and intangibles impairment in continuing operations (mainly ADD Solutions) and ₹58.3 cr total exceptional write-offs, below EBITDA
₹35 cr transaction costs incurred so far on the divestment, with ~₹20 cr more expected; ESOP and legal/transaction costs weigh on EBITDA

quality.why: Consolidated revenue growth of 20% YoY includes Cloud Wave (₹16.5 cr, only a few weeks owned) and the headline ₹47.3 cr PAT is driven by the ₹129.3 cr divestment gain, while continuing operations posted a ₹48.1 cr loss after ₹38.4 cr impairment; retained revenue growth of 30% YoY is the cleaner recurring signal, driven by defence and XiDA volume, but the brief does not split price vs volume.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guides post-ESOP EBITDA margin about 15% in Q3 and at least 20% in Q4, versus H1 reported EBITDA of ₹11.4 cr (pre-ESOP ₹23.4 cr), with ESOP falling to single-digit % of EBITDA by Q4 and corporate overhead cut to about ₹12 cr per quarter.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No new productive capacity commissioned in the window; the Telangana MAC is live only in 1-1.5 years plus about 6 months certification, with interim operations from the Bangalore facility.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q3 revenue guided at ₹285-300 cr and Q4 at ₹375-405 cr, with H2 execution of ₹600-720 cr against ₹379 cr executed so far, backed by named DRDO (₹120 cr in Q3, ₹150 cr in Q4) and MoD orders.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management says it is consciously building large-scale manufacturing infrastructure, but no utilisation figure is disclosed and the only capex named is MAC land, so a new capex announcement is not firmly signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Q3 core revenue growth guided at 30%+ QoQ (45-50% band) and Q4 about 30% QoQ, but management declined to call these formal guidance and the FY27 target is re-based to about ₹1,000 cr-plus plus ₹60-150 cr from acquisitions.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Phase 2 closure has slipped from November to February, and the ₹1,100 cr Q4 gain depends on it; supply-chain lead times of 12-18 months carry a ±2% margin risk, and acquisitions could slip one to two quarters on ITAR/CFIUS approvals.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new product, brand or model launch was discussed; the call covered order wins and acquisitions, not launches.

rows.label: Phase 2 Akkodis proceeds reduce net debt
rows.why: Net debt was ₹556 cr at 30 Sep 2026 and ~₹1,274 cr of guaranteed consideration is pending, with the ₹504 cr February receipt tied to Phase 2 closure targeted by February 2027.

rows.label: Acquisitions add ₹600-750 cr of revenue if closed
rows.why: About 4 targets are lined up with 2-3 aimed for Q4 FY27, adding ₹600-750 cr if closed, but ITAR and CFIUS approvals could slip them one to two quarters.

rows.label: Akkodis divestment gain of about ₹1,100 cr
rows.why: Management said it is 100% confident the Phase 2 closure (US$206 mn) yields a one-time gain of about ₹1,100 cr, though closure has already slipped from November to February.

tone.note: Management was confident on the strategic pivot, Q4 margin of at least 20% and Phase 2 closure, but hedged on PAT, the FY27 revenue target and defence forecast language; analysts pressed on margin basis (pre vs post ESOP), the divested-business margin drop and the earn-out risk.
